description: Deliberately seeded resources for PS-027 detection testing. Each hostname is a distinct DNS name so that IPv6 behaviour can differ per resource without touching the apex domain.

resources.note: Root document. Both A and AAAA records; IPv6 works end to end.
IPv6-capable CDN host. Everything on it should PASS over both families.
No AAAA record at all. The classic 'IPv4-only dependency': the apex may be IPv6-ready but this image is not.
AAAA record exists and is advertised, but nothing accepts TCP connections on that address/port. Demonstrates that an AAAA record is not proof of reachability.
TCP connects over IPv6, but the TLS handshake on that path is deliberately broken (server drops the ClientHello).
TCP and TLS succeed over IPv6, but the HTTP layer on that path always returns 500.
